title: Join the Ropes
statement:
You have `n` ropes with lengths `l_1 ... l_n`. Joining two ropes of lengths `x` and `y` costs `x + y` and produces one rope of length `x + y`. Join all ropes into one rope as cheaply as possible.

Print the smallest total cost. With a single rope the cost is `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `l_1 ... l_n`.

## Output
Print the smallest total cost.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= l_i <= 10^9`
